defects.summary: Buckets are contiguous chunks whose high edge is inclusive (Bucket.high/overlaps) while the rest of the module treats a range as [low, high); a key at a boundary is compared by two buckets and the ranges are not the ranges range_digest uses.

MerkleTree.build takes the key order once and then reads store.state.records per bucket while the shard keeps accepting writes, so the tree is built over a torn view (and a deleted key raises KeyError); a digest walk needs a snapshot.

differing() resolves equal generations with right[0] >= left[0], adopting the scanned-second replica; the rule is the version vector and, for concurrent versions, the greatest writer identifier, so the loser of the tie can be written forward.
